title: CropKeep – Farming + Tower Defense Roguelite | Out Now (Demo Available)
author: Maximum-Nature-5050
selftext:
**After about six months, my first game is finished and now on sale on Steam.**

I started out not knowing how to use AI at all. At first I just asked it questions, then cross-checked its answers and set things up myself. Later on, I let the AI take over the JSON files directly and fix whatever I asked it to.

Game interactions, monster reactions, behavior patterns, mercenary behavior, and the dog character’s behavior were all done through vibe coding. My usual workflow: play for a while, write down 5–10 things I wanted changed, and hand the list to the AI.

Some of the art was AI-generated, then I used Aseprite to remove backgrounds and resize.

The most tedious part was that everything had to be iterated by hand. From start to finish, I went through over 3,000 versions.

Since this was my first release, I didn’t really know how to use Steam. I didn’t set up my store page in advance, it only went up in early November. When I launched on 11/13, I had just 50 wishlists.

That hurt. With so few wishlists, I got no launch traffic, and I missed Steam Next Fest entirely.
